_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
I ye jokelani {player_id} o tɛ Tic Tac Toe.
O tɛgɛnin ye kojugu kɛlɛ san (dɔw, kɔrɔn, walla kɛlɛkɛlɛ) kanburu kunni.
O tɛgɛn dɔ, i bɛɛ sɛbɛn kɔnɔ kɛlɛ lakika (0-8) i bɛɛ fɔ o fɔlɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ.
Sɛbɛn, '[4]' fɔ i fɔlɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ kɛlɛ kanburu kunni kɔrɔn.
Ka jokelani {player_id}, i bɛɛ '{symbol}', wɔle o tɛgɛla ye '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} tɛ sɛli ɲuman ye. A ka kan ka kɛ 0 ni 8 cɛ.
invalid_move.already_occupied: O yɔrɔ nin tɔɔ bɛɛ ye {cell}.

game_action.placed: Jokelani {player_id} daa fɔlɛ kɛlɛ ({symbol}) kɔnɔ kɛlɛ {cell}.

outcome.draw: U bɛɛ bɛnna a la ko an tɛna bɔnɛ foyi sɔrɔ.
